notes: Payloads captured by running mintRuntimeCancellationAuthToken against the real signer and decoding the JWT; the volatile iat/exp claims are stripped.

A run with a projectId gets the projectScoped shape via mintProjectScopedServiceToken, whose tokenUse claim defaults to project_scoped_service_account. A projectless run gets the projectless shape via mintAuthenticatedUserToken, a plain user session with no tokenUse.
projectless.payload.email comes from the run requester's user record and jti is freshly generated per mint, so only their presence and type are contractual.
